title: Prepare native GitHub six-hour courtesy reservations
goal: Use native Issues, sub-issues, dependencies, comments, assignees and Projects; no bot or custom tracker.
acceptance_criteria: One issue points to one immutable packet revision; native blocked-by and phase parent relationships mirror its prerequisite IDs.
Contributor comments with packet identity and proposed six-hour interval; maintainer acknowledges/assigns and records UTC start/expiry in the issue or Projects field.
Expiry, cancellation and reassignment are manual coordination actions; stale reservations never authorize merge or change the frozen contract.
human_review: Maintainer qualification of repository permissions, manual reservation/reassignment procedure and readiness gate
scope_rule: Only explicitly sealed artifact/file scope; meaning, checker, workflow, release and reporting changes require dedicated independent human review.
null_binding_reason: Project source and concrete declarations are not yet bootstrapped; maintainer must instantiate and freeze this template before any live claim.
